title: US-057 Park an installation that is waiting for parts
description: Mariia adds an Awaiting Parts value to the Installation Status picklist, so a job held up by a missing part stops being counted as late. This is the story the business signs off in Lab 3.10.
commitMessage:
US-057 Park an installation that is waiting for parts

Awaiting Parts value on Installation__c.Status__c, so the weekly report
stops counting a job held up by a missing part as late.
prTitle: US-057 Park an installation that is waiting for parts
prBody:
Planners cancel and recreate an installation when a part does not arrive, which loses its history.
This gives them a status to park it in.

- `Installation__c.Status__c`: new restricted picklist value `Awaiting Parts`

Story: US-057 in BACKLOG.md
nextStep: Review it and merge it into integration, then take the next story: Lab 3.10 step 2 gives the order.
